I applied no entries. The only one, §check-fails-open, is about `set -e` and the exit status, and it says nothing about comments, headers or `CHECK_LIMIT_KB`. My edit doesn't touch `set` or `exit`. A comment isn't a new decision, so I didn't add anything to PRECEDENT.md.

**`CHECK_LIMIT_KB` in check.sh (original line numbers)**
```
5	limit_kb=${CHECK_LIMIT_KB:-512}
...
8	  kb=$(( $(wc -c < "$f") / 1024 ))
9	  [ "$kb" -gt "$limit_kb" ] && echo "$f (${kb}KB)"
```
The default is set only on line 5, as 512. It's a limit in KB (1024 bytes). A staged file is flagged when its size in bytes divided by 1024 (rounded down) is greater than the limit. With the default, that means files of 513 KB or more. Being over the limit only prints a warning; the script still exits 0.
